==================
NS_ENUM with identifier underlying type
==================

typedef NS_ENUM(NSUInteger, SDCallbackPolicy) {
    SDCallbackPolicyFireAndForget = 0,
    SDCallbackPolicyEnsureExecute = 1,
};

---

(translation_unit
  (type_definition
    (enum_specifier
      (type_identifier)
      (type_identifier)
      (enumerator_list
        (enumerator
          (identifier)
          (number_literal))
        (enumerator
          (identifier)
          (number_literal))))))

==================
NS_OPTIONS with shift values
==================

typedef NS_OPTIONS(NSUInteger, SDImageCacheOptions) {
    SDImageCacheRetryFailed = 1 << 0,
    SDImageCacheLowPriority = 1 << 1,
};

==================
CF_ENUM and CF_OPTIONS siblings
==================

typedef CF_ENUM(uint32_t, MyCFEnum) {
    MyCFEnumA = 0,
};

typedef CF_OPTIONS(uint32_t, MyCFOptions) {
    MyCFOptionsA = 1 << 0,
};

typedef NS_CLOSED_ENUM(NSInteger, MyClosed) {
    MyClosedA = 0,
};

---

(translation_unit
  (type_definition
    (enum_specifier
      (primitive_type)
      (type_identifier)
      (enumerator_list
        (enumerator
          (identifier)
          (number_literal)))))
  (type_definition
    (enum_specifier
      (primitive_type)
      (type_identifier)
      (enumerator_list
        (enumerator
          (identifier)
          (binary_expression
            (number_literal)
            (number_literal))))))
  (type_definition
    (enum_specifier
      (type_identifier)
      (type_identifier)
      (enumerator_list
        (enumerator
          (identifier)
          (number_literal))))))

==================
Enumerator with availability between name and value
==================

typedef NS_OPTIONS(NSUInteger, SDWebImageOptions) {
    SDWebImageAvoidDecodeImage API_DEPRECATED("Use SDWebImageContextImageForceDecodePolicy instead", macos(10.10, 10.10), ios(8.0, 8.0)) = 1 << 18,
    SDWebImageScaleDownLargeImages = 1 << 20,
};

---

              (string_content))
            (version
              (platform)
              (number_literal)
              (number_literal))
            (version
              (platform)
              (number_literal)
              (number_literal)))
          (binary_expression
            (number_literal)
            (number_literal)))
        (enumerator
          (identifier)
          (binary_expression
